description: Guidelines Evolve learned with guidelines_prompt=rules from one Claude Code session on shopkit (add an optional nickname field to users; commit rejected once for the changelog and client version). Served in the Nov 11, 2026 evaluation: Codex and Claude Code, adding discount_code to orders.

guidelines.content: Before committing in this repository, update `CHANGES.md` by adding an entry under the `## Unreleased` section describing the change, and bump `clients/python/VERSION` to the next minor version when a new field is added to the Python client.

metadata.rationale: The pre-commit hook explicitly checks for a `CHANGES.md` entry under `## Unreleased` when `schema/models.yaml` changes, and requires `clients/python/VERSION` to be bumped (minor) when `clients/python/shopkit_client.py` changes. Omitting either causes the commit to be rejected.
metadata.trigger: When `schema/models.yaml` is modified and/or `clients/python/shopkit_client.py` is regenerated (e.g., after adding a field to any model).
implementation_steps: Open `CHANGES.md` and add a bullet under `## Unreleased` describing the schema change (e.g., `- Users have an optional \`nickname\` text field.`).
Open `clients/python/VERSION`, read the current version (e.g., `1.3.0`), and increment the minor segment by one (e.g., `1.4.0`) for a new field addition.
Stage both files with `git add CHANGES.md clients/python/VERSION` before running `git commit`.
metadata.task_description: In this repository, add an optional `nickname` field (text) to users. It should be stored and loaded like the other user fields and accepted by the Python client. Commit the change when it is ready to merge.

guidelines.content: When adding a new field to a model, follow the four-step sequence: (1) edit `schema/models.yaml`, (2) run `make generate` to regenerate `shopkit/models.py` and `clients/python/shopkit_client.py`, (3) run `make migration NAME=<change>` to create the SQL migration, (4) run `make check && make test` to verify consistency before staging.

metadata.rationale: `schema/models.yaml` is the single source of truth; the Python model, the Python client, and SQL migrations are all derived from it. Running the generation and migration tools ensures all derived artifacts stay in sync, and `make check` confirms they match before committing.
metadata.trigger: When adding, removing, or changing any field in any model in this repository.
implementation_steps: Edit `schema/models.yaml` to add the new field under the appropriate model (e.g., `nickname: {type: str}`).
Run `make generate` from the repository root to regenerate `shopkit/models.py` and `clients/python/shopkit_client.py`.
Run `make migration NAME=<descriptive_name>` (e.g., `make migration NAME=user_nickname`) to auto-generate the numbered SQL migration file in `migrations/`.
Run `make check && make test` to confirm generated code and migrations are consistent with the schema and all tests pass.
Update `CHANGES.md` and `clients/python/VERSION` as required by the pre-commit hook before committing.
